plugin.plugin_forms.name: Forms
plugin.plugin_forms.description: Your own questions for members: a button opens the form, the answers arrive in a channel of your server, to accept or decline.
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.forms_hint: Members open a form with /form <name> or the button of /form-panel <name>.
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.forms.name: Name (for /form and the panel)
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.forms.title: Title
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.forms.questi: Questions (one per line, max. 5; add "(long)" for a big text box, "(optional)" for an optional one)
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.forms.once: Only one open answer per member
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.reviewers_hi: Who may accept or decline. Empty: everyone who sees the answers channel.
plugin.plugin_forms.setting.ping_role_hi: This role is mentioned with every new answer (optional).
plugin.plugin_forms.node.open.label: Open Form
plugin.plugin_forms.node.open.descriptio: Opens a form for the member (needs a command or button).
plugin.plugin_forms.node.panel.label: Post Form Panel
plugin.plugin_forms.node.panel.descripti: Posts the text and button of a form in a channel.
